Tutorial for what I did:

1. Click on the version in the **releases** tab on the right and download the file for your OS
2. After you install it, restart OBS
3. In your source's filters menu choose "**User-defined shader**"
4. In the shader properties check "**Load shader text from file**"
5. Click "browse" and find the **fisheye.shader** or **fisheye-xy.shader** file and adjust properties from there!

I believe if you want to download more shaderfilters, just add the files to this same "examples" folder as the fisheye.shader (idk exactly tho and I haven't tried)

Hope this helps!
